description: Floating popover for block comments with thread-list, thread-detail, and new-thread views, rendering thread cards, nested entries with reactions, watch, resolve, and read, and reply, edit, and delete actions.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the TmNotionCommentDraftState value changes - the new-thread/thread-reply composer, the inline reply or the entry edit gained/lost content. Value-equality deduped, so it does NOT fire on every keystroke. No composer text is observable through a parameter; use TmNotionCommentDraftState to build a dirty-guard before closing the panel or navigating away. The inline reply's auto-inserted quote and an untouched edit are not user content and do not raise HasUnsavedContent. Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard after the consumer's own confirmation.
